You will serve as a Sea-Launched Cruise Missile (Nuclear) (SLCM-N) Program Analyst at Strategic Systems Program (SSP) in Washington, DC.
You will provide special technical analysis and guidance on procurement, budget execution, and the strategy and planning for SSP.
You will support the SP leadership to integrate SLCM-N acquisition with the development and maintenance of technical documentation, technical design, prototype, and development of the required documents in support of acquisition reviews.
You will support the development of the overall SSP test strategy, technical data package reviews, weapon system analysis, subsystem objective and quality evidence.
You will support the development of integrated master schedules, action plans, and inchstones used to ensure technical rigor is maintained for strategic weapon systems.
Your resume must also demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the NH-03 (GS-13) grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector.

Specialized experience must demonstrate the following: Provide technical analysis and guidance for major defense systems acquisition to support acquisition planning, budget execution, and lifecycle management in meeting program objectives.

Additional qualification information can be found from the following Office of Personnel Management website:Program Management Series 0340 Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.

Dafür entwickelst du mit modernen No-Code- und Low-Code-Tools wie n8n, Zapier, Make.com oder Airtable maßgeschneiderte interne Anwendungen, verbesserst bestehende Workflows und setzt KI-basierte Automatisierungen ein, um Prozesse effizienter und smarter zu gestalten.

Automatisierung & KI-Nutzung: Du entwickelst Systeme, die durch Automatisierung und KI echten Mehrwert schaffen – z. B. im Kundenservice, Reporting oder bei internen Abläufen.

This position will serve as a Behavioral Health Interdisciplinary Program (BHIP) Program Manager at the Mosley CBOC in Aurora, Colorado.

As a BHIP Program Manager, the Psychologist assists in planning, establishing, and implementing policies and procedures, developing individual or group goals and objectives, as well as monitoring, operating, evaluating, coordinating, and overseeing the multidisciplinary staff of their assigned BHIP team(s).

Provides program management and oversight of interdisciplinary BHIP team(s). Maintains administrative supervisory responsibility of all direct reports and Team Lead responsibility of all other members of their BHIP team(s).

Oversees the implementation of BHIP services, including ensuring that appropriate processes/procedures are followed, Veteran care needs are addressed, and Veteran complaints are addressed.

Identifies procedural issues related to BHIP treatment and care coordination and works toward process improvement in coordination with the other BHIP Program Coordinators, Program Managers and the Section Chief.

Ensures the multidisciplinary staff under their supervision are aware of and adhere to all current directives and handbooks of the Veterans Affairs Administration, meet current applicable Joint Commission standards, state licensure standards, and VA-OIG oversight requirements.

Oversees and/or ensures that appropriate processes are identified and followed related to BHIP sub-programs, such as psychological testing and groups. Develops and maintains high-quality team functioning and processes while meeting all Environment of Care and programmatic requirements.

Works closely with the Primary Mental Health Section Chief, Mental Health Service leadership, other Mental Health program leadership, and other services through the VA Eastern Colorado Health Care System. Fosters a cohesive interdisciplinary team environment.

Oversees quality control issues and performance measures in collaboration with the Primary Mental Health Section Chief and throughout VA ECHCS. Assists the Section Chief in overseeing compliance with the successful execution of Mental Health Performance Measures, SAIL, workload, VERA capture, Veteran patient satisfaction, and quality assurance.

Utilizes the service recovery model with Veteran patients who express dissatisfaction or concerns regarding their mental health care as requested; provides consultation for all mental health clinicians regarding the clinical care of complex cases.

Provides overarching supervision, including annual performance ratings, for direct report employees, including Psychologists, Social Workers, and Licensed Professional Mental Health Counselors (LPMHC).

Provides Team Lead oversight of all members of the BHIP team(s), including non-direct report staff, such as Psychiatrists, Nurse Practitioners, Physician Assistants, Clinical Pharmacists, Nurses, and Peer Support Specialists.

Clearly communicates established guidelines and performance expectations for staff through the formal employee performance management system. Develops functional statements and performance standards. Observes workers' performance, demonstrates and conducts work performance critiques.

Provides informal feedback and periodically evaluates employee performance. Identifies training needs of employees and arranges training as appropriate. Works to resolve informal complaints and grievances; develops work improvement plans recommending personnel actions as necessary.

Conducts individual, group, and couples therapy and psychological assessment for Veterans engaged in BHIP. Work Schedule: Monday-Friday 8 AM - 4:30 PM Virtual: This is not a virtual position.

Applicants pending the completion of educational or certification/licensure requirements may be referred and tentatively selected but may not be hired until all requirements are met.

Basic Requirements: Education: Have a doctoral degree in psychology from a graduate program in psychology accredited by the American Psychological Association (APA), the Psychological Clinical Science Accreditation System (PCSAS), or the Canadian Psychological Association (CPA) at the time the program was completed.

The specialty area of the degree must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed. For the purpose of meeting this requirement, the term "specialty area" refers to the specific specialty areas recognized by the accrediting body and not to specific job duties that might require special skills.

Currently, APA accredits doctoral programs in the specialty areas of clinical psychology, counseling psychology, school psychology, or combinations of two or more of those areas. PCSAS accredits doctoral programs in psychological clinical science.

CPA accredits doctoral programs in clinical psychology, counseling psychology, clinical neuropsychology, and school psychology. There are no job assignments in VHA that require the skills of a school psychologist; therefore, an applicant with a degree in the specialty area of school psychology is not eligible for appointment.

Strictly for the purpose of determining eligibility for appointment as a psychologist in VHA, there is no distinction between the specialty areas (with the exception of school psychology).

OR Have a doctoral degree in any area of psychology and, in addition, successfully complete a re- specialization program (including documentation of an approved internship completed as part of the re- specialization program) meeting both of the following conditions: The re-specialization program must be completed in an APA or a CPA accredited doctoral program; and, the specialty in which the applicant is retrained must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

OR Have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally-accredited institution, with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature.] AND Internships Have successfully completed a professional psychology internship training program that was accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed and that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed OR New VHA psychology internship programs that are in the process of applying for APA accreditation are acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement, provided that such programs were sanctioned by the VHA Central Office Program Director for Psychology and the VHA Office of Academic Affiliations at the time that the individual was an intern; OR VHA facilities that offered full-time, one-year pre-doctoral internships prior to PL 96- 151 (pre- 1979) are considered to be acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement; OR Applicants who completed an internship that was not accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed may be considered eligible for hire only if they are currently board certified by the American Board of Professional Psychology in a specialty area that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

(NOTE: Once board certified, the employee is required to maintain board certification.) OR Applicants who have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally- accredited institution with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature may fulfill this internship requirement by having the equivalent of a one-year supervised internship experience in a site specifically acceptable to the candidate's doctoral program.

If the internship experience is not noted on the applicant's official transcript, the applicant must provide a statement from the doctoral program verifying that the equivalent of a one- year supervised internship experience was completed in a site acceptable to the doctoral program.

Licensure: Hold a full, current, and unrestricted license to practice psychology at the doctoral level in a State, Territory, or Commonwealth of the United States, or the District of Columbia. Exception.

Non-licensed applicants who otherwise meet the eligibility requirements may be given a temporary appointment as a "graduate psychologist" at the GS-11 or GS- 12 grade under the authority of 38 U.S.C. § 7405 [(c)(2)(B)] for a period not to exceed two years from the date of employment on the condition that such a psychologist provide care only under the supervision of a psychologist who is licensed.

Failure to obtain licensure during that period is justification for termination of the temporary appointment. Grade Determinations: Psychology Program Manager, GS-14 Experience: At least three years of experience as a professional psychologist, with at least one year equivalent to the GS-13 grade level.

Demonstrated Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: In addition to the experience above, the candidate must demonstrate all of the following KSAs: Ability to organize work, set priorities, delegate tasks, and meet multiple deadlines.

Knowledge of and ability to utilize evidence based practices and clinical practice guidelines appropriately and ability to guide staff in using these tools. Ability to deal effectively with individuals or groups. Skill in managing and directing the work of others to accomplish program goals and objectives.

Ability to translate management goals and objectives into well-coordinated and controlled work operations. Ability to establish and monitor production and performance priorities and standards. Ability to analyze organizational and operational problems and to develop and implement solutions that result in sound operation of the program.

Preferred Experience: Experience providing outpatient mental health treatment through BHIP, Mental Health/BHIP supervisory experience, Clinical experience providing evidence based psychotherapy. Reference: For more information on this qualification standard, please visit https://www.va.gov/ohrm/QualificationStandards/.

The full performance level of this vacancy is GS-14. The actual grade at which an applicant may be selected for this vacancy is GS-14 Physical Requirements: Physical demands of the work are generally minor, as the position requires sitting, standing, and walking.

The emotional demands can be stressful in working with high-risk for suicide veteran population and their families. A high level of self-awareness is essential. Work is primarily sedentary. May require prolonged standing, moderate walking, and manual dexterity. Requires carrying light items, such as books, files, or laptop computer.

As a Commercial Project Manager for the Aerospace, Defense, & Marine BU, you will help lead commercially driven initiatives that bring structure, alignment, and momentum to complex customer-focused work.

Based in a remote role, you will partner with cross-functional stakeholders to organize projects, clarify priorities, and support execution across programs tied to customer engagement, customer centricity, and customer performance .

This is a newly created opportunity for an experienced project professional who can bring discipline to ambiguity, connect business needs to actionable plans, and keep broad teams moving in the same direction.
You will join an environment where projects are centered solving business and customer challenges that may involve multiple teams, sites, and functions. In this role, you will help shape how commercial initiatives are structured and managed, supporting efforts such as ongoing customer-focused programs and the commercial TEOA journey .

This is a strong fit for someone with proven project management capability, strong business and customer acumen , and the ability to translate complex needs into practical next steps across a distributed organization.

Lead commercially driven projects that require strong coordination across functions, with a focus on customer-related priorities and business outcomes.
Bring structure to complex initiatives by helping define project scope, organize activities, and guide stakeholders through execution in a clear and disciplined way.
Translate customer needs and business requirements into actionable plans, helping teams understand what must happen to move from problem identification to resolution.
Track program and stakeholder progress, helping ensure actions are assigned, followed through, and aligned to agreed timelines and expectations.
Support problem-solving efforts for complex customer situations that cannot be resolved by a single person, team, or site, bringing the right stakeholders together to move work forward.
Apply project management tools and practices such as planning, coordination, accountability, and timeline management to commercial initiatives in a practical and effective way.
Contribute to ongoing initiatives related to operational excellence on the commercial side , helping teams build ownership and accountability as projects advance.
Work across internal teams to maintain alignment, identify blockers, and help keep projects progressing through the appropriate steps and decision points.

Experience in project management within a business, commercial, or cross-functional environment where influence and coordination are critical to success.
Strong business acumen and customer acumen , with the ability to understand customer needs and connect them to practical internal actions.
Demonstrated strength in structure, process, problem solving, and big-picture thinking .
Ability to work effectively in roles that involve significant cross-functional collaboration, stakeholder management, and shared accountability.
Confidence operating in situations with ambiguity, where projects are still being defined and require someone who can create clarity and forward motion.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to bring people together, align different perspectives, and maintain focus on priorities.
A balanced approach that combines process discipline with flexibility, especially in ongoing programs that evolve over time.
Comfort working with teams that include subject matter experts, using their input to build coordinated plans without needing to be the technical expert in every area.
What you'll need
Proven ability to manage projects using core project management practices such as planning, scope management, timeline coordination, and stakeholder follow-through .
Experience supporting programs that involve multiple stakeholders and require consistent accountability across functions.
Readiness to work in a remote position while staying closely connected with internal teams and business partners.
Familiarity with customer-focused business environments where progress depends on coordination across teams rather than direct authority.
Ability to assess incoming priorities, organize next steps, and help determine which actions and stakeholders are needed to achieve project goals.
Willingness to step into a newly created role and help establish a strong foundation for how commercial projects are managed going forward.

At TE Connectivity , you will have the opportunity to help define a new role with meaningful visibility and impact. This position offers the chance to support important commercial priorities in a way that directly influences how teams respond to customer needs, organize complex work, and improve execution across the business.
You will be part of a collaborative environment where strong project leadership is valued, especially in situations that require alignment across functions and thoughtful problem solving.

The role also offers the flexibility of a remote working model , along with exposure to strategic commercial initiatives and ongoing operational excellence efforts.

For someone who enjoys turning complexity into coordinated action and partnering with others to drive progress, this is a strong opportunity to contribute in a highly connected role at TE Connectivity .

Psychologist program managers have broad program management responsibilities for a specific program or programs that are designed to deliver specialized, complex, highly professional services that are important program components of the facility and that significantly impact the health care provided to Veterans.

Por isso, aqui temos espaço para todas as pessoas, independente de raça, gênero, idade, orientação sexual, crença religiosa ou deficiência. 🏳️‍🌈👩🏾‍🦽
Nosso objetivo - Potencializar os negócios dos nossos clientes através de soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis. Topa vir com a gente nessa? 🎯
Sobre a posição
Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar como Technical Project Manager , responsável pela condução de projetos enterprise de Digital Commerce , combinando gestão de projetos, relacionamento com stakeholders e sólida capacidade técnica.
A posição terá papel central na conexão entre negócio, produto e tecnologia, garantindo clareza de escopo, planejamento, alinhamento entre equipes e qualidade das decisões técnicas ao longo do projeto.
Esperamos uma pessoa com experiência relevante em e-commerce B2C e B2B , conhecimento avançado da plataforma VTEX e capacidade para participar ativamente da definição de arquiteturas de solução e integrações. Perfil esperado
Procuramos uma pessoa que não atue apenas no acompanhamento operacional do projeto. O Technical Project Manager deve possuir profundidade técnica suficiente para compreender as soluções propostas, questionar decisões, identificar riscos e conduzir discussões de arquitetura , sem necessariamente assumir a responsabilidade pela implementação.
Também esperamos forte capacidade de relacionamento com clientes e stakeholders, organização para atuar em ambientes complexos e habilidade para transformar discussões técnicas e de negócio em planos de execução claros e objetivos.
Principais responsabilidades
Planejar e conduzir projetos enterprise de Digital Commerce , acompanhando escopo, cronograma, riscos, dependências e entregas.
Atuar como principal ponto de conexão entre stakeholders de negócio, times técnicos e demais áreas envolvidas no projeto.
Gerenciar escopo, prioridades e expectativas, conduzindo negociações com stakeholders quando houver mudanças, riscos ou conflitos de prioridade.
Conduzir cerimônias e processos de desenvolvimento utilizando Scrum e metodologias ágeis .
Estruturar planos de trabalho, acompanhar evolução das entregas e garantir visibilidade clara sobre status, riscos e próximos passos.
Traduzir necessidades de negócio em direcionamentos compreensíveis para os times técnicos.
Participar da definição e revisão de arquiteturas de solução , considerando requisitos funcionais, integrações, escalabilidade e restrições da plataforma.
Conduzir agendas técnicas relacionadas a arquiteturas de integração e fluxo de dados entre VTEX, ERPs, CRMs, OMS, sistemas de pagamento, logística, marketplaces e demais plataformas corporativas.
Trabalhar em conjunto com arquitetos, desenvolvedores e especialistas para avaliar alternativas técnicas e apoiar decisões de solução.
Garantir alinhamento entre arquitetura, escopo acordado e objetivos de negócio.
Identificar antecipadamente riscos técnicos ou funcionais que possam impactar prazo, escopo ou qualidade da solução.
Organizar e conduzir workshops, refinamentos técnicos, sessões de discovery e alinhamentos de arquitetura.
Estruturar roteiros de demonstração , preparando cenários que evidenciem as principais capacidades e entregas do projeto.
Realizar demos, apresentações executivas e reuniões de acompanhamento com clientes, lideranças e diretorias.
Comunicar temas técnicos de forma clara para públicos não técnicos, contextualizando impactos, riscos e decisões.
Requisitos
Excelente capacidade de comunicação, organização e planejamento .
Experiência comprovada na gestão e condução de projetos enterprise .
Experiência prática com Scrum e metodologias ágeis .
Experiência com gestão de escopo, riscos, dependências e negociação com stakeholders.
Experiência com projetos de e-commerce B2C e B2B .
Inglês fluente , com capacidade para conduzir reuniões, apresentações e discussões técnicas.
Conhecimento técnico avançado da plataforma VTEX e de seus principais componentes e capacidades.
Conhecimento técnico avançado suficiente para elaborar, discutir e validar arquiteturas de solução .
Experiência com arquiteturas de integração entre plataformas de e-commerce e sistemas corporativos.
Capacidade de compreender APIs, integrações, eventos, fluxos de dados e dependências entre sistemas.
Experiência conduzindo reuniões técnicas com arquitetos, desenvolvedores, equipes de integração e stakeholders de negócio.
Capacidade de produzir materiais executivos e apresentar soluções, entregas e decisões para públicos de liderança.

Leiter Mattertal Tunnel (m/w/d), 80\-100%
=========================================
Das Herzstück der BVZ Holding bilden das Bahnunternehmen Matterhorn Gotthard Bahn und die
internationalen Top Marken Gornergrat Bahn und Glacier Express. Leidenschaftliche und qualifizierte
Mitarbeitende bilden die Grundlage unseres Erfolges. Täglich engagieren sich rund 700 Mitarbeitende, um unseren Gästen ein erstklassiges Erlebnis zu bieten. Wir leben Vielfalt und haben eines gemeinsam:
**Emotionen sind unser Antrieb. Was ist dein Antrieb?**
Für den Mattertal Tunnel, der künftig die ganzjährige ÖV\-Verbindung zwischen Täsch und Zermatt sicherstellt, setzen wir in der Planung auf BIM. Dafür suchen wir eine initiative Persönlichkeit in **Brig/Glisergrund und/oder Täsch/Zermatt** als **Leiter Mattertal Tunnel (m/w/d), 80\-100%**

* Du übernimmst die Gesamtprojektleitung seitens Bauherrn für das Projekt Mattertal Tunnel von der Planung über die Ausführung bis zur Inbetriebnahme
* Du führst ein interdisziplinäres Team von internen Mitarbeitenden und externen Partnerfirmen und arbeitest aktiv im Leitungsteam des Bereichs Infrastruktur mit
* Du leitest, koordinierst und überwachst Planungs\-, Ausschreibungs\- und Bauarbeiten und verantwortest die Kommunikation mit Behörden sowie externen Stakeholdern
* Du stellst die Projektabwicklung gemäss Projektmanagement\-Konzept der BVZ/MGB\-Gruppe sicher und sorgst dafür, dass Budget, Termine und Qualität eingehalten werden und übernimmst das Vertrags‑ und Nachtragsmanagement
* Du wirkst in weiteren Bahninfrastrukturprojekten hauptsächlich im Bereich Tunnelbau mit (je nach Verfügbarkeit)

* Du verfügst über einen Abschluss als Bau\- oder Elektroingenieur an einer Universität / Fachhochschule oder über eine vergleichbare Ausbildung – idealerweise ergänzt durch Weiterbildungen in Betriebswirtschaft und Projektmanagement.
* Ausgewiesene Berufserfahrungen in der Leitung von grossen Bauprojekten, idealerweise im Bereich Tunnel\- und Bahnbau sind ein Muss
* Du hast ein sehr gutes technisches Verständnis, fundierte Kenntnisse der Bahninfrastruktur und ein grosses Interesse für die Mobilität der Zukunft.
* Du bringst viel Eigeninitiative, Umsetzungsstärke, ein vernetztes und ausgeprägtes unternehmerisches Denken und hohe Sozialkompetenz mit
* Du bist eine gewinnende Person mit guten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
* Als belastbare Persönlichkeit mit zuverlässiger Arbeitsweise konntest du deine Führungs\- und Projektleitungserfahrung bereits in einer ähnlichen Branche unter Beweis stellen.

* Eine herausfordernde Schlüsselrolle für eines der bedeutendsten Infrastrukturprojekte in der Geschichte der MGBahn
* Hohen Gestaltungsspielraum und Aufbau eines Teams in einem multidisziplinären Umfeld
* Zusammenarbeit mit engagierten Fachleuten und Entscheidungsträger:innen
* Flexibles Arbeiten von unterwegs und von zu Hause möglich
* GA\-FVP und weitere attraktive Benefits für dich und deine Familie
Motivationsschreiben sind von gestern! Wir freuen uns über deine kurzen und knackigen Antworten zu folgenden Fragen:
* Was ist dein Antrieb, bei der MGBahn diese Funktion als Leiter Mattertal Tunnel zu übernehmen?
* Was ist dir in einem Team wichtig?
* Du bist einzigartig! Was sollten wir unbedingt über dich wissen?

Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?
Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.
Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.
Notre vision
Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.
Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.
Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.
À propos de Pennylane
Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

s.h: En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à
s.t:
💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant
💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1200 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!
🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible
🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours
🚀 Déjà plus de 1 300 000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !
Pourquoi ce poste est fait pour toi?
Tu as envie de comprendre aussi bien l’aspect technique que le business sales. Tu souhaite réfléchir à la configuration et aux solutions avec les devs ET parler efficacité commerciale avec les sales managers.
Le contexte
Ce poste fait partie de Sales Strategy & Operations, l'équipe centrale qui pilote toute la stratégie revenue de Pennylane. C'est une équipe de 10 personnes, et tu participeras au succès et de la scalabilité de notre machine commerciale.
Le poste
L’objectif est de devenir une source d’informations et solutions pour l’équipe Sales, les débloquer, et les rendre toujours plus efficaces.
Pour cela, tu vas aider à comprendre leurs contraintes, prioriser, et piloter les projets qui impactent vraiment leur productivité (configurations Salesforce, intégrations outils, optimisations, IA...).
Avec une forte dimension apprentissage et projet, tu vas monter progressivement en expertise sur notre stack (Salesforce, Modjo, ChiliPiper, Ringover, Dust...) et devenir clé pour que l'équipe Sales scale efficacement.
Missions principales
Tu seras le point de référence technique pour l'équipe Sales (100+ personnes) sur tous les sujets CRM et outils commerciaux. Tes responsabilités principales:
Comprendre les besoins des équipes Sales - Identifier les problématiques qui ralentissent ou limitent les commerciaux (productivité Salesforce, workflow d'appels, pipeline accuracy...)
Qualifier et prioriser - Challenger les demandes, saisir ce qui a vrai impact, et prioriser avec le reste de l'équipe Sales Strat & Ops
Piloter les projets - De la spécification à la mise en production : cadrer, planifier, coordonner avec l'équipe tech, tester, communiquer, et accompagner la conduite du changement
Supporter les utilisateurs - Assurer un support efficace et scalable sur Salesforce et les outils satellites. Identifier les patterns et les opportunités d'optimisation.
Monter en expertise - Apprendre progressivement les méthodologies de gestion de projet, l’analyse data, Salesforce et comment les équipes commerciales fonctionnent vraiment.
Note: Nous cherchons quelqu'un avec le goût d'apprendre, pas quelqu'un qui sait déjà tout!
Profil recherché
Junior avec une petite expérience (1-2 ans) OU profil en transition vers les outils CRM/Sales Ops
Profil technico-fonctionnel - à l'aise aussi bien avec le technique qu'avec le métier
Curiosité et soif d'apprendre - tu aimes découvrir et maîtriser de nouveaux outils/concepts
Ouverture d'esprit - tu as envie d’apprendre différentes perspectives (tech ET business)
Process de recrutement
Screening Interview avec Nathalie - Talent Acquisition - 30 minutes.
Manager Interview avec Maud - Associate Team Lead Technical Partner - 45 minutes.
Business Case direct avec Maud et un autre membre de l'équipe - 1 heure.
Final Round avec Nicolas - Head of Sales Ops et un autre membre de l'équipe - 45 minutes.

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)
🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)
🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés
🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking
🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris
💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE
🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib
💻 Un Mac
🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

s.h: Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra
s.t:
-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)
-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant
-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes
-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.
Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.
Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !
Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s
Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.
Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).
Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @ pennylane.com ou ----- .
Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Cloud Project Manager
PFH Technology are currently looking for a Cloud Project Manager to join our growing team.

As a Project Manager, you will be responsible for managing a portfolio of cloud projects across multiple client environments, with a strong focus on AWS and Microsoft Azure.

Projects may include application migrations from on-premise environments to cloud platforms, the design and implementation of cloud-native solutions, technology upgrades, DevOps enablement, and operational improvement programmes.

The role requires strong client-facing project management capability, the ability to coordinate technical teams and stakeholders, and the discipline to ensure projects are delivered to agreed scope, timelines, quality standards, and commercial commitments.
Location: Remote – with very occasional travel to client sites across Ireland required.

Manage a portfolio of AWS and Azure cloud projects across a number of client environments, ensuring delivery is aligned to agreed scope, timelines, budgets and quality expectations.
Lead project delivery for cloud migration, cloud-native solution implementation, technology upgrade, DevOps implementation and operational improvement initiatives.
Chair client project status meetings, providing clear updates on progress, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions and next steps.
Prepare and maintain project documentation, including project plans, status reports, risk and issue logs, action trackers, meeting minutes and decision records.
Write and support the production of Statements of Work, ensuring scope, assumptions, deliverables, effort estimates, dependencies, exclusions and acceptance criteria are clearly defined.
Arrange and coordinate internal and client-facing project meetings, ensuring agendas are issued, actions are tracked and meeting minutes are produced promptly.
Manage client stakeholders, technical teams, third-party vendors and internal delivery resources to maintain momentum and ensure effective project governance.
Identify, manage and escalate project risks, issues, dependencies and change requests, ensuring appropriate mitigation and resolution plans are in place.
Perform quality assurance on project deliverables, ensuring outputs are complete, accurate, fit for purpose and aligned to agreed acceptance criteria.
Coordinate project handover into operational support, ensuring documentation, knowledge transfer, support processes and service readiness activities are completed.
Provide concise reporting to internal management and client stakeholders, highlighting project performance, delivery risks and decisions required.

Proven experience managing IT, infrastructure or cloud projects in client-facing environments.
Understanding of AWS and/or Microsoft Azure project delivery, including cloud migration, platform implementation, cloud-native solution delivery and technology upgrade projects.
Experience managing multiple concurrent projects or a portfolio of work across different clients, teams and priorities.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage confidently with client sponsors, technical teams, vendors and internal management.
Strong written communication skills, including experience producing Statements of Work, meeting minutes, project reports, action logs and governance documentation.
Good working knowledge of project governance, risk management, issue management, change control and quality assurance processes.
Self-motivated, organised and delivery focused, with strong judgement, problem-solving ability and attention to detail.
Relevant project management accreditation such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or Scrum certification is desirable;
Cloud certifications such as AWS Cloud Practitioner or Microsoft Azure Fundamentals would be beneficial.

## Your Purpose ##
The LNG Manager is responsible for inspecting the construction and outfitting of the related LNG equipment and that fitting is done according to international regulation, ship-s contract, technical specifications, and builder standards.

This role is controlling the quality of the materials used, the compliance with regulation and with IGF Code and highlighting any discrepancies within the approved project.

Potential adjustments when minor technical issues are identified by this role, during the construction phase, may be recorded and shared within the Site team and new building division as lesson learnt to be implemented on next projects.

* Ensures that areas under the described discipline are built within the set timescale and in line with the approved technical design, contractual requirements, and functional requisites.
* Follows the installation and outfitting of all LNG equipment and piping maintaining accurate and up to date records of all activities and inspections.
* Attends project meetings and prepares progress reports.
* Ensures that all commissioning activities are held in accordance with the scope and the specifications, are approved by class and relevant authorities such us Flag and USCG representatives.
* Suggests minor adjustments as may be found necessary on site and follows implementation and development of any architectural / technical design change.
* Highlights relevant aspects of the approved design that can be improved for future constructions.
* Involves the Technical Site Specialist(s) during the construction and commissioning phase to ensure that technical accessibility and functionality of equipment is duly verified.
* Highlights relevant aspects of the ship-s design and technical features that might jeopardise the functional requisites and must be improved for the current project or can be improved for future constructions with new building department approval.
* Assists with Plan Approval activities as required.

* Good knowledge of IGF Code.
* Good knowledge of piping, electrical machinery inspection is a plus as she/he may be requested to cooperate with the technical teams for the daily inspections included within the ship-s construction.
* Experience in a leadership position on board LNG vessels or cruise ships with LNG duty might be beneficial.
* Proficiency with the use of Microsoft Office (including Excel, MS Word, MS Project or equivalent and PowerPoint);
* Familiarity with Marine Rules and International Standards and Regulations.
* Ability to review new building specifications and to read and understand a variety of engineering drawings.

The Constructive Dialogue Institute (CDI) is a non-partisan, non-profit dedicated to equipping the next generation of Americans with the skills to communicate and collaborate across lines of difference.

We work with U.S. colleges and universities by providing co-curricular programming for students, professional development for faculty and staff, and strategic guidance to leadership. CDI was co-founded by psychologist Jonathan Haidt, the bestselling author of The Righteous Mind and The Anxious Generation .

The Constructive Dialogue Institute (CDI), a nonpartisan nonprofit dedicated to strengthening civic culture through constructive dialogue, seeks an experienced, mission-driven Program Manager, Live Programs to own the delivery of our most complex partner engagements as our training and educational programs scale.

## Description de l'emploi ##
Le Pôle prévention et solidarités (PPS) de la Direction de l'insertion et des solidarités (DIRIS), rattachée à la Direction générale de la cohésion sociale (DGCS), est un pôle dynamique et pluridisciplinaire actif dans les dispositifs de maintien à domicile, de soutien aux proches aidant·e·s ou encore de lutte contre les violences.
Afin de renforcer ses compétences, le PPS recherche **un·e** **Chef·fe de projet** pour assurer la conduite et la coordination du programme cantonal de soutien aux personnes proches aidant·e·s.
Pour de plus amples informations, veuillez consulter le cahier des charges ici ou contacter Mme Anne Clausen, Responsable du Pôle prévention et solidarités (PPS), à l'adresse email : dgcs.recrutement@vd.ch
## Responsabilités ##
* Conduire le programme cantonal de soutien aux personnes proches aidantes et assurer la mise en œuvre des priorités cantonales visant à renforcer l'accompagnement et la reconnaissance des proches aidant·e·s.
* Coordonner les collaborations avec les acteur·trice·s concerné·e·s, assurer le suivi des dossiers stratégiques et parlementaires.
* Assurer le suivi des prestations déléguées pour le soutien aux proches aidant·e·s et le développement de nouveaux projets, mandats ou prestations.
* Développer des outils de pilotage et d'évaluation, et participer à l'analyse des besoins ainsi qu'à l'évolution des prestations et mesures de soutien.
* Représenter la Direction au sein de différentes plateformes et instances spécialisées, tout en assurant une veille des évolutions législatives, scientifiques et des pratiques innovantes dans le domaine.
* Assurer la coordination des actions de communication, de la campagne de sensibilisation et de promotion des prestations cantonales de soutien aux personnes proches aidantes avec l'ensemble des parties prenantes aux niveaux cantonal et intercantonal. Participer ou assurer la coordination intercantonale des actions de communication annuelle et de la journée des personnes proches aidantes (JPA).

* Master ou titre jugé équivalent, exigé.
* Formation en administration publique ou titre jugé équivalent, souhaité.
* Expérience professionnelle de 5 ans minimum dans la gestion de projet.
* Solides connaissances des enjeux et développements concernant la proche aidance.
* Sens des responsabilités et éthique du service public.
* Capacité d'organisation, de gestion du temps, d'adaptation et de flexibilité.
* Très bonne capacité rédactionnelle.
* Écoute et communication.
* Bonne expression orale et esprit d'entraide et de collaboration.

La Direction générale de la cohésion sociale (DGCS) propose aux habitant·e·s du Canton de Vaud des mesures d-accompagnement et d-insertion, des prestations d-hébergement en institutions médicosociales ainsi que des aides financières. Avec plus de 450 collaborateur·trice·s investi·e·s, nous nous engageons à favoriser la qualité de vie de nos différents publics en œuvrant pour davantage de justice sociale dans notre Canton.
Nous offrons une organisation de travail autonome et flexible avec notamment la possibilité de télétravailler.
Notre culture et notre environnement de travail sont axés sur la diversité et l'équité. Enfin, nous prônons au quotidien des valeurs humaines telles que la solidarité, le respect et la confiance.
Pour plus d-informations, cliquez ici afin de consulter notre site.
